description: Aerospace systems for Earth observation and planetary missions Established in 2006, Spin.Works is a Portuguese aerospace company specializing in the development of advanced systems for space and terrestrial applications. The firm designs and manufactures optical instruments, computer vision systems, artificial intelligence, and navigation and control systems for Earth observation, as well as planetary missions to the Moon and Mars. Since 2008, Spin.Works has been actively involved in space-related technology development, contributing to significant European Space Agency (ESA) programs. Key projects include developing a smart landing system for the Argonaut, the first European spacecraft mission to the lunar surface, and creating mechanisms for the Space Rider, a robotic space vehicle. The company is also a contributor to the New Space Portugal initiative, developing hyperspectral cameras for the Atlantic Constellation of satellites. In addition to its core aerospace and defense markets, Spin.Works has ventured into the agricultural technology sector with its proprietary subscription-based application, MAPP.it. Launched in 2017, MAPP.it utilizes AI and remote sensing data from satellites and drones to provide plant-level insights for precision agriculture, initially serving top wine growers in Portugal and now operating on three continents. The company's expertise also extends to image processing software for opto-electronic sensor-based detection systems and end-to-end engineering for ground segment satellite communication systems.

description: This company appears to be a manufacturer of dehydrators, with a focus on food-related applications BBKW, a Lisbon-based company established in 2015, specializes in the manufacturing of advanced drying equipment for the agri-food and pharmaceutical sectors. The firm's inception stems directly from its leadership's past experience as aromatic herb producers, where they encountered the challenge of drying products efficiently without incurring prohibitive energy costs. This firsthand knowledge led to the development of their proprietary drying solutions. The company's core business revolves around designing and building custom, low-temperature dehydrators. Its product line includes the patented 'Black Block' hybrid solar dryer and the 'White Block' dryer, which is specifically designed for medical cannabis. A distinctive feature of BBKW's offering is the transformation of recycled maritime containers into modular, hybrid solar drying chambers. These units utilize patented solar walls that convert sun radiation into dry air, a process that can slash energy consumption by up to 80% compared to conventional systems. For continuous operation, the system is augmented with dehumidifiers and air conditioning, managed by an intelligent IoT controller. This proprietary controller and software system allows clients to remotely monitor and manage all drying parameters, generating detailed audit trails and high-precision reports for compliance and process optimization. BBKW's business model consists of direct sales of its custom-built drying units, standalone controllers, and ancillary equipment, along with providing installation services. The company has demonstrated a global reach, with installations in Portugal, Morocco, Spain, Vietnam, and South Africa, among others. Initial funding was secured through a grant in November 2015 from investors including EIT InnoEnergy and EDP Starter.

description: Real-time predictive maintenance for commercial vehicle fleets. The company has secured significant funding to support its growth, including a €3 million round in 2019 and a $12 million Series A round in 2021 led by Forestay Capital. description: Agent-free, transparent real estate transaction infrastructure. Turnki is building transaction infrastructure that enables fully autonomous property transactions across Europe — replacing intermediaries with technology. The platform provides a complete transaction layer from listing to closing, allowing property owners, buyers, developers, and institutional funds to transact directly without traditional agents. The company operates at the intersection of PropTech (listing and search), LegalTech (automated compliance and digital contracts), FinTech (payment processing and escrow), and AI (document verification and fraud detection). THE PROBLEM €267B flows annually to property intermediaries across Europe — the continent's last major undigitized transaction layer within an €8.5T market. Agents charge 5-8% commissions (€15-24K on average transactions) under exclusive contracts, while controlling viewings, offers, and communication between parties. 92% of property searches start online, but 0% close online — not because technology doesn't exist, but because no infrastructure existed to replace the intermediary function end-to-end. THE SOLUTION Turnki provides a 6-layer transaction infrastructure stack that replaces every function traditionally performed by property agents: Layer 1 — Market Intelligence: Price discovery, comparable analysis, and listing tools. Layer 2 — Matching & Discovery: AI-powered search and buyer-seller matching. Layer 3 — Coordination: Viewing scheduling through a trained ambassador network, communication hub, and progress tracking. Layer 4 — Verification (Proprietary): A 3-layer verification engine built entirely in-house — digital identity verification (30 seconds), AI-powered document validation (minutes vs. days manually), and physical property inspection via ambassador protocol. This engine automates extraction and validation of property certificates, handles co-ownership orchestration with unanimous consent protocols, and eliminates 87% of post-sale disputes. Layer 5 — Transaction: SIBS payment rails (€100B+ annual processor) with Multicert eIDAS-compliant digital signatures, legally binding across 27 EU countries. Layer 6 — Closing: Mortgage integration and digital handover coordination through certified lawyers. Professional support is embedded but non-intermediary: certified lawyers coordinate each transaction (assigned automatically, similar to Uber driver allocation), and trained ambassadors handle property viewings under strict protocols — they facilitate logistics, not negotiation. BUSINESS MODEL Turnki charges a transparent success-only fee: €2K fixed + 2% variable (minimum €4K variable), resulting in approximately €8K per €300K transaction — 60% cheaper than traditional agents. The 2.7% take rate on GMV follows infrastructure economics (comparable to Stripe's model for payments), not advertising economics (Idealista, Rightmove). Zero exclusivity required. Zero upfront costs. WAVE 2 DISINTERMEDIATION Turnki sits within the second wave of platform disintermediation. Wave 1 (2010s) aggregated intermediaries — Idealista, Rightmove, Zillow kept agents in the loop. Wave 2 replaces them entirely — as Stripe replaced merchant reps and Wise replaced FX brokers. Turnki replaces property agents with direct transaction rails. TECHNOLOGY AND DEFENSIBILITY The proprietary verification automation engine represents an estimated €2-3M and 18-month replication cost for competitors. Operational partnerships with SIBS (payment processing) and Multicert (digital signatures) are live. The multi-jurisdiction compliance framework covers Portugal and Spain, with EU-wide expansion capability under eIDAS and DSA regulations. Each completed transaction compounds the platform's data advantage in verification accuracy, price prediction, and fraud detection. VALIDATION AND TRACTION 95% user preference across 40+ user tests. NPS 72 (vs. 32 industry average). 217 lawyers registered organically at €0 CAC, with €5K switching cost each. The company has completed end-to-end autonomous transactions through the platform. Pre-revenue status is by design: supply-first strategy solves the marketplace cold-start problem before consumer launch, with €500K from the raise dedicated to building a 600-property supply foundation through B2B partnerships. MARKET AND EXPANSION Entry market: Iberia (Portugal + Spain), representing €3.3B in annual agent commissions. European TAM: €267B annually. Global ceiling: $700B. Target: 310 transactions at M24, generating €93M GMV and €2.48M revenue at 44% gross margin. TEAM FUNDING Raising €3M seed at €13.64M pre-money valuation (18% equity). 24-month runway to Series A readiness. KEYWORDS Transaction infrastructure Property

description: The leading certified emissions engine turning carbon data into compliance, digital product passports, and measurable commercial value ZeroPact is a certified emissions intelligence platform engineered to transform raw environmental data into compliance, operational efficiency, and measurable business growth. As global regulations enforce strict carbon accounting and anti-greenwashing measures—such as the EU Empowering Consumers Directive (EmpCO), CSRD, and FuelEU Maritime - companies face an urgent need to substantiate environmental claims and quantify footprint data at scale. ZeroPact addresses this shift by replacing slow, expensive legacy consulting and manual reporting tools with an automated, portfolio-wide platform. The platform operates across four primary high-value solutions: 1. Automated Life Cycle Assessments (LCA): Generates portfolio-scale, ISO 14067:2018-certified LCAs instantly, delivering precise product carbon footprinting (PCF) at a fraction of traditional costs. 2. Digital Product Passports (DPP): Enables one-click DPP generation that turns compliance QR codes on physical products into interactive digital channels for consumer engagement, lead capture, e-commerce integration, and post-purchase support. 3. Emissions Intelligence & Last-Mile Tracking: Provides decision-level transparency into product supply chains and last-mile logistics - adhering to the GLEC framework - broken down by route, vehicle, client, and date. 4. EmpCo Compliance: Delivers auditable evidence to ensure full compliance with regulatory directives, effectively protecting brands against greenwashing risks. Beyond consumer goods and logistics, ZeroPact’s core engine expands into specialized verticals including software carbon intensity tracking and maritime biofuel carbon credit arbitrage. Recognized as one of WIRED's Hottest 100 Startups in Europe (2025) and certified by SGS, ZeroPact delivers LCA automation up to 90%+ cheaper and in minutes rather than months, helping enterprise clients across retail, energy, and logistics - such as El Corte Inglés, CTT, PRIO Energy, and Sogrape - turn sustainability mandates into a competitive advantage
